My crock holds 6 medium cabbages. I got these cabbages on sale so their outer layer is bruised and wilted. Peel that layer off and rinse.

Next, slice the cabbage in half and core.

Slice the halved cabbage like so and use your food processor to shred. My processor can shred a whole cabbage- once it's shredded I dump the cabbage directly into my crock and add two leveled tablespoons of coarse salt per medium cabbage. I enjoy adding some caraway to my kraut and then I stir it all together and mash it down.

I do this layer after layer until all six cabbages are in the crock. This is what it looks like when I'm done.

I'll leave it like so and then "burp" it this evening (press it down to release the gas build-up) and will burp every day until it stops fermenting/bubbling.

It's a really easy thing to make and it's also inexpensive and healthy!
